Title: Public preview expansion: VNet Service Endpoints and Storage Firewalls and Virtual Networks

Body.Content:
The public previews for Virtual Network Service Endpoints and Firewalls and Virtual Networks for Azure Storage have been expanded to include all regions in the Azure public cloud.

For more information about VNet Service Endpoints, see Virtual Network Service Endpoints (preview).

For more information about applying network security to Azure Storage, see Configure Azure Storage Firewalls and Virtual Networks (preview).
